name: W Nashville
positioning: A Rockwell Group-designed hotel in Nashville's Gulch neighborhood, with local art throughout, a rooftop facing Downtown and the Batman Building, and José Andrés restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led base in the Gulch, moments from Broadway and Music Row
Suite guests and travelers bringing a pet

facts.text: W Nashville is in Nashville's Gulch neighborhood.
The hotel is moments from Broadway, Music Row, 12 South, SoBro, Midtown and the Arts District.
The hotel's aesthetic was developed by the Rockwell Group.
Every room has a hint of the retro jet-age, with sleek lines and pronounced curves.
The hotel has custom elevator panels by Nashville leatherworker Joey Verzilli.
Kelsey Montague's What Lifts You wings mural is also featured on the hotel's southern exterior.
Guest rooms have a mirrored bar outfitted with what is needed to mix a cocktail.
The Penthouse Suite bedroom has a soaking tub, dual vanities and a rain shower.
Premier Suites have views over the WET Deck.
The FIT gym offers fitness classes led by local instructors, from yoga to movement seminars.
José Andrés has launched Zaytinya, Bar Mar and Butterfly at W Nashville.
Through the P.A.W. program, the hotel offers pet beds, bowls and toys.

highlights.text: The rooftop has views of the Batman Building and Downtown Nashville.
An edition of FAILE's Southern Skies hangs in every guest room.
The Spanish Steps connect the WET Deck to the second floor, where the FIT gym and Yoga Lawn are.
The Den is a retreat in the Welcome area reserved for suite guests with key-card access.
The Penthouse Suite has a large living room, a kitchen and a wet bar.

considerations.text: W Nashville draws a young crowd.
Lower Broadway is about a 15-minute walk from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may bring street noise from the busy downtown area.
